messages:
alice: Solaris Systems (INV-2026-722) called — promo STACK50 appears twice on invoice, customer says only one apply. Can finance confirm and resolve?
ben: link https://billing.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-722 — snippet:
```
STACK50   -$50.00
STACK50   -$50.00
Usage     $120.00
```
billing-bot: Alert: promo_duplication_detector matched STACK50 on INV-2026-722. Flagged for manual review.
dave: Likely duplicate at promotion merge. Recommend one reversal credit $50, reason "duplicate STACK50". Accounting code ACCT-PROMO-REV.
claire: Approve. I can sign off for credits <= $100. Mark approved by claire.
ben: running `/billing create-credit INV-2026-722 --amount 50.00 --reason "duplicate STACK50" --acct ACCT-PROMO-REV --approved-by claire`
ben: CLI: `Success: credit CR-2026-899 created; invoice updated; ledger LB-2026-145 appended.`
billing-bot: Audit: CR-2026-899 applied to INV-2026-722; note "duplicate STACK50 reversed per manager approval".
support: Notified Solaris via SUP-50123 that $50 credit applied and invoice updated.
alice: Confirmed customer received credit. Closing loop — thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
